data.name: Dacan Express: Logistic manager
data.detailed_description:
Step into the ruthless world of delivery services in Dacan Express: Logistics Manager. Under the watchful eye of your uncompromising CEO, start in the Dacancenter hub with a 100,000 € budget. Your goal? Optimize your logistics network, outsmart corporate giants on the daily leaderboard, and claim market dominance!

Key Features:

  • 🏢 6 Regional Depots & Active Leaderboard: Expand your network from Dacancenter into 5 unlockable city districts (East, South, West, North, Southwest). Every midnight, the system evaluates your daily NPS score to shift market share in an organic zero-sum game against Global Parcel Giant and Turbo Delivery.

  • 👥 HR Management & The "Carpet" Meetings: Recruit couriers and dispatchers with dynamic skill sets. Every 5 levels, unlock advanced specializations by choosing between two distinct traits. Is staff morale dropping? Summon them to your office for intense contract renegotiations regarding wages and bonuses!

  • 📦 2 Dispatcher Modes & Urgent Pickups: Toggle your dispatchers with a single click between rapid mail sorting and processing customer claims to boost NPS. Keep an eye on the map to deploy drivers for time-sensitive, high-reward urgent pickup requests.

  • 🚐 Fleet Management & Maintenance: Deploy inner-city vans for residential zones and heavy trucks for bulk inter-depot cargo transit. Vehicles suffer realistic wear and tear based on delivery volumes and weather, requiring timely repairs to avoid operational breakdowns.

  • 📅 Seasonal Forecasts & Weather Systems: Monitor the internal event calendar to survive high-volume shopping spikes like Black Friday, Christmas, or Back-to-School rushes. Dynamic weather variations (Sunny, Rain, Snow) actively alter courier capacity and vehicle degradation.

data.short_description: Welcome to Dacan Express! Build, manage, and expand your own logistics empire in this solo-developed management game. Hire staff, negotiate contracts, and keep your couriers on the move. 👉 Please Wishlist the game on Steam!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better / OpenGL 3.3 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio output
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 16:9 aspect ratio. Integrated graphics may require lower settings.
